positiveGuards: AX node role is heading and AX name matches rendered heading text.
Direct AX child nodes are static text, line break, or transparent generic/strong/emphasis/none wrappers.

Trailing NBSP is direct StaticText immediately after direct LineBreak.

No spoken-space item added for LineBreak without trailing NBSP StaticText.
No rule for same-text non-heading controls.
No rule for ARIA role=heading; C.5 proved native heading behavior only.
No site URL, class, copy, or Royal Mail specific condition.
